name: Montenegro

fees.name: Short-stay visa C (tourism/visit, embassy/VAC sticker visa)
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Consular fee published on official VFS Global Montenegro one-pagers (Contentful CDA, space xxg4p8gt3sg6): Short Term Visa EUR 35; minor children under 14 pay EUR 17.50. Montenegro is NOT a Schengen member, so the Schengen fee does not apply. Fee not itemised on gov.me (only 'proof of payment of consular fee' is required).

fees.name: Short-stay visa C (business)
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same C-category consular fee schedule as tourism per VFS Montenegro one-pager fee tables.

fees.name: Transit visa (B category)
fees.notes: VFS Montenegro one-pager lists an identical fee table (Short Term EUR 35 / Long Term EUR 35 / minors under 14 EUR 17.50) under the B Category - Transit Visa section.

fees.name: e-Visa
fees.notes: Montenegro does not operate an e-visa or eTA programme; applications are lodged at embassies/consulates or VFS visa application centres. Holders of valid Schengen, US, UK or Irish visas/residence permits may enter visa-free for up to 30 days per government policy.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: No visa-on-arrival regime; visas must be obtained in advance.

vfs.note: Published VFS Montenegro Visa Application Centre service charge varies by centre: EUR 30 online-payment (Uzbekistan), EUR 31-32 (Kazakhstan centres), EUR 35 incl. tax (other centres). Montenegro routes applications via VFS Global in 12+ source countries (RUS, UZB, KAZ, ARE, ARM, AZE, BHR, KGZ-region, NPL, PHL, QAT, SAU, TUR).

free_visa_notes: Citizens of ~100 countries (EU, USA, GBR, CAN, RUS, and many others) enter Montenegro visa-free for up to 30 or 90 days. Additionally, foreigners holding a valid Schengen visa, US/UK/Irish visa, or residence permit of those areas may enter without a Montenegrin visa for up to 30 days. No fee schedule differences by nationality were found for those who do need a visa (flat EUR 35 consular fee on all inspected VFS corridors).
